title: Governance Platform Hardening
objective: Make the governance platform itself deterministic, trustworthy, and self-consistent before allowing it to govern the repository.

phase_0.title: Governance Architecture Freeze
phase_0.purpose: Freeze the governance platform architecture before implementing WS1-WS9.

specification_drift_policy.policy: After Phase 0.75, no workstream may modify frozen architecture or specifications.
specification_drift_policy.process: If implementation reveals incorrect specification, implementation must stop. Change must be proposed through new ADR and specification update. Only after specification update may implementation continue.
specification_drift_policy.purpose: Prevent 'fixing the spec in code' and keep architecture as source of truth.

status_note: ALL 9 workstreams (WS1-WS9) are now fully IMPLEMENTED against every readiness-checklist item (103/103 total checks passing), verified live. WS4's previously-disclosed data-completeness gaps (event_graph/schema_graph empty; no graph-vs-source validation) were closed by building two new, conservative, deterministic parsers: event_matrix_parser.py (parses the single canonical docs/EVENT-OWNERSHIP-MATRIX.md table, resolving subsystem names to document paths via exact filename transforms plus a small, hand-reviewed override list -- 19 of 39 names resolve to 78 real graph edges; 21 genuinely ambiguous/generic names, e.g. 'Dashboard', 'Runtime', 'Audit', are deliberately left unresolved and excluded from the graph rather than guessed, see event_graph_resolution_report.json) and schema_reference_scanner.py (exact literal schemas/*.json filename matches in document prose text only, no fuzzy matching -- 18 real references resolved, 1 correctly left unresolved as a genuine near-miss). A new graph_source_validator.py module also closes the final WS4 gap: every one of 11 content-derived graphs is now verified to trace back to real, currently-indexed source documents (wired into IntegrityEngine.check_graphs()). See .governance/programme_2.5/WORKSTREAM-STATUS-ROLLUP.json and each ws{N}/manifest.json for full itemized, live-executed evidence.
